home.title: What would you like to understand?
home.lead: Take a photo. We explain it in simple words and read it aloud.

med.title: Scan a medication label
med.text: Tablets, syrups, creams. See the dose and when to take it.

bill.title: Scan a polyclinic bill
bill.text: See what you pay and which subsidies may apply.

home.sample: Not sure? Try a sample first

keep.title: Keep a daily schedule
keep.text: Scanning works without an account. Log in to save your medicines and share them with family.

frame.medication: Fit the whole label inside the box
frame.bill: Fit the whole bill inside the box

light.title: Good light
light.text: Near a window or under a lamp. No flash glare.

flat.title: Lay it flat
flat.text: Smooth out folds. Hold bottles so the label faces you.

whole.title: Everything in the frame
whole.text: Include all four edges, even the small print.

scan.samplesTitle: Nothing to scan? Try a sample
scan.photoHint: Hold the phone steady in good light, with the whole page inside the box.
scan.photoKept: Your photo is still on this phone, so you won’t need to take it again.
scan.cameraBlocked: We can’t open the camera. Allow camera access in your browser, or use Upload photo.

lead.medication: Change anything that is wrong. Parts we couldn’t read are marked Please check.
lead.bill: Fix any amount that doesn’t match the paper bill.

confirm.needsCheck: {n} field needs checking | {n} fields need checking
confirm.allFilled: ✓ Everything is filled in. If it matches your paper, press {ok}.
confirm.couldntRead: We couldn’t read this, so nothing is filled in. Check the label or ask the pharmacist.
confirm.okDisabled: Fill in the parts marked Please check to continue.

med.name: Medicine name
med.other: Other instructions on the label (one per line)

bill.smudged: Please check: this part is hard to read on the photo.
bill.mismatch: Please check: the amounts don’t add up to this total.

med.title: Take {amount} {unit}, once a day. | Take {amount} {unit}, {times} times a day.

food.before: Take it before you eat, when your stomach is empty.
food.after: Eat your meal first, then take the medicine. This is gentler on the stomach.
food.with: Take it together with your meal.
food.any: You can take it with or without food.

med.daily: Keep taking it every day, even when you feel well. Do not stop unless your doctor tells you to.
med.askTitle: Ask your pharmacist how to take this medicine.
med.askText: These instructions don’t fit a daily timetable, so we have not added this medicine to a schedule.

bill.title: You pay {amount}.
bill.p: Subsidies are already taken off your bill. The MediSave amount is paid from your CPF MediSave account, not in cash.

check.title: Quick check
check.medWrong: Not quite. It is {amount} {unit} each time.
check.askQ: Should this medicine go on a daily schedule?
check.askRight: That’s right. Ask your pharmacist when to take it.
check.askWrong: Not quite. It doesn’t follow a daily timetable, so ask your pharmacist.
check.billQ: How much do you need to pay?

player.unavailable: Read-aloud in this language is not available on this device yet.
